svg.font-family: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.title: Import model dialog, Import run settings (dark theme)
svg.desc: The Import run flyout open above the Import button's chevron: threads and jobs at once with their defaults (one per core), and the workers and queue of each pipeline, texture workers set to 4 with the override bar and a reset; the chevron carries the custom-run dot. Behind it, The Import model dialog with three files listed and Car.fbx selected alone. Name and content folder rows, then an informational InfoBar with the file's facts. Below, two columns separated by a splitter: the file list with its icon-only toolbar; the import settings panel, drawn with the editor's shared property editors (PropertiesExpander groups of PropertyCard rows: Units and axes expanded with the Result row, which says what the import does to the model's size and orientation in Oxygen's space, then Units (Metres) and Up axis; Geometry, Hierarchy, Textures and Lights collapsed; Materials, last as its rows vary with the file, expanded: each source material is a PropertyCard with the material picker button, Glass set to the project's Glass material with its override bar and reset). The facts InfoBar spans the width: a warning bar titled 3 warnings, whose action button, Before import, opens the report as a flyout. The button bar holds Open session and Save session on the left, Import 3 with its chevron (Import disabled while the name of Crates.gltf is taken; its chevron opens the Import run settings) and Cancel. Colours are WinUI 3 dark-theme tokens.
svg.text: 3 files · each is analysed before it is imported, without loading its buffers · they import as one run
